title: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound image sequences based on radiomics analysis for diagnosis of metastatic cervical lymph nodes from thyroid cancer.
summary: Prospective CEUS video radiomics in 75 pathologically confirmed thyroid-cancer lymph nodes used tracking, feature selection, and SVM/LDA/decision-tree models; best SVM-RFE+SVM accuracy was 93.3% under leave-one-out validation. Small cohort limits clinical generalization.
